name: Takeda Sakuya
source:
Asuka's classmate.  Comes from a wealthy family.  Has a strong sense of responsibility, is prideful, stubborn and lives by the concept of the so-called [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noblesse_oblige]noblesse oblige[/url].  For some reason, she acts cold towards Asuka when they first meet.  Currently going out with Itsuki.

[Translated from [url=http://hakuai.kogado.com/character/#sakuya]Official Site[/url]]
